module: ImGui "Material Selector" window (300 x 500) to pick a material, with thumbnails and a search bar. Used by the editor's decal tools. It lists the materials of Sim.getMaterialSet() filtered by tag (decal for decal patches, RoadAndPath for decal roads) and calls a callback with the chosen material name.
usage:
local msm = require('editor/toolUtilities/materialSelectionMgr')
msm.registerWindow()  -- at initialization
msm.openWindow()
-- every imgui frame:
msm.handleMaterialSelectionSubWindow(false, function(matName) ... end)
notes: The material list is computed only once (on first display) and then kept.
At most 5 thumbnail textures are loaded per frame (loadedTextures reset to 0 on each display); the others appear in the following frames. A load failure is remembered (false).
The filter: isDecal true keeps materials tagged 'decal', false keeps those tagged 'RoadAndPath' (tags read with getField('materialTag', 0..2)). Empty names are ignored.

getTexObj.desc: Returns the texture object for an absolute path, loading it via editor.texObj if needed (limited to 5 loads per frame). Returns false if loading failed, nil if the limit is reached before the first attempt.

registerWindow.desc: Registers the 'materialSelect' window in the editor (editor.registerWindow).

handleMaterialSelectionSubWindow.desc: To be called every frame: draws the window (search + scrolling list of materials with a diffuseMap thumbnail) and calls onSelectMaterialFunct(materialName) on click. Hides the window if there are no materials.

isDecal.desc: true: decal patches ('decal' tag); false: decal roads ('RoadAndPath' tag).

onSelectMaterialFunct.desc: Callback called with the chosen material name.
